verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requests manuscript content containing questions designed for readers moving into leadership for the first time.
The client establishes a flexible manuscript chapter-length acceptance condition of approximately 4,000–6,000 words.
The client accepts the proposed 4,000–6,000-word manuscript chapter range stated in the immediately preceding proposal.

The client defines this as a question-and-answer chapter with a variable question count governed by the book-wide word limit, superseding the prior chapter-length policy; the removed key exists in the replayed state.
The client explicitly ends the project, removing the outstanding obligation to deliver the first-time-leader chapter.
